labels.notes: Camera-captured Chinese linear algebra textbook, page 5. Dense mathematical content with matrix proofs, Fourier matrix, determinants. Crisp typed text, clean page. Moderate grayish fading on text.

Camera-captured Chinese linear algebra with MathType 5.0 equation editor watermarks. Eigenvalues, Schur decomposition, block matrices. Prominent diagonal page fold/crease creating shadow across page. Illumination is the main issue.

Camera-captured Chinese document about face detection (Haar-like features, AdaBoost classifiers). Haar feature diagrams visible. Finger at left edge. Clean typed text with good structure. Moderate fading.

Camera-captured Chinese document about Python TypeError debugging for get_mail function. Numbered debugging steps with Python code snippets. Well-structured, good readability. Slightly faded but better contrast than most.

Screen capture of handwritten convex optimization notes. Table structure (domain, conjugate functions). Fenchel's/Young's inequality. Heavy cyan/blue moire grid pattern severely degrades clarity. Black ink with red annotations.

Camera-captured Chinese document with Python code for image frequency analysis (image_high_freq_counts). Improvement notes section. Finger visible at bottom right. Clean typed text, slightly faded gray.

Screen capture of handwritten Chinese linear algebra notes about Schur's theorem and Cayley-Hamilton theorem. Red/pink annotations, black main text. Toolbar visible. Moderate moire pattern from screen capture.

Screen capture of handwritten Chinese convex analysis notes. Black ink, dense mathematical notation with set operations and proofs. Relatively clear handwriting, less moire than typical screen captures.

Screen capture of handwritten convex optimization notes (epigraphs, sublevel sets, concavity). Red and black ink. Heavy red-tinted moire/grid pattern. Small graph illustration with blue shading. Mixed Chinese/English. Dense but degraded by moire.

Screen capture of handwritten Chinese physics notes about uniform circular motion. Blue ink on lined paper. Kinematic diagrams, velocity/frequency/period formulas. Toolbar visible. Moderate moire pattern.
